title: What Loads Dust Into HVAC Returns Near Fairfax
headline: Cool basements, oak pollen, and why City of Fairfax registers get dusty again
description: The City of Fairfax sits inside a heavy Fairfax County tree canopy. An educational look at why 1950s–80s ramblers sweat at the trunks, how pollen sticks, and when to clean the ducts.

sections.heading: The City of Fairfax is small. The pollen load is not.
paragraphs: Old Town Fairfax, Fairfax Corner, and the streets toward George Mason do not look like a forest. Drive any block in May and the cars are yellow. Oak and maple from the surrounding county dump pollen onto every outdoor surface. Returns pull it in. A rambler with a full basement then stores it in the coolest metal in the house — the supply trunks.
Those trunks get cold when the AC runs. Indoor air in July is wet. Condensation forms. Dust sticks. That is the film you wipe off a register on Monday and see again on Friday.

sections.heading: Why ramblers and split-levels fail in a specific way
paragraphs: A lot of Fairfax housing went up between the 1950s and 1980s with a basement air handler. Later additions spliced new branches onto old trunks. Joints there collect whatever the last decade of filters missed. Townhomes at Fairfax Corner add a second failure: dryer vents that turn too many times before the cap.
If wiping the registers only lasts a few days, when you are ready to book, use the [Fairfax, VA location page](/locations/fairfax).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Fairfax house
paragraphs: You do not need a lab test to decide the system is overdue. Watch for:
listItems: Gray film on upstairs supplies during peak pollen.
Musty air from basement registers in July.
A dryer that needs two cycles in a Fairfax Corner townhome.

sections.heading: Background reading vs booking a visit
paragraphs: Fairfax jobs are scheduled from our metro offices. This article is educational — use the [location page](/locations/fairfax) when you are ready to book.
Fairfax is served from our [Burke](/locations/burke) office. Nearby [Springfield](/locations/springfield) and [McLean](/locations/mclean) use the same dispatch.
Packages live on the [Fairfax location page](/locations/fairfax). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) if the laundry room stays hot.
listItems: Change filters when pollen is heavy, not only at the printed interval.
Keep basement humidity under 50% in summer.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Is this a sales page for Fairfax duct cleaning?
faq.a: No. This post explains mechanisms and signs. Service details live on the Fairfax location page.

faq.q: What usually causes gray film on supply registers?
faq.a: Fine particles that bypass or overload filters settle in cool trunks and recirculate when the blower runs.

faq.q: When is dryer vent cleaning the better first step?
faq.a: When laundry closets stay hot, dry times double, or you smell burnt lint — clear the vent to the exterior cap.
